name: A Life Plus
description: A Life Plus (A+) offers a convenient and healthy way to eat, with chef-made, dietitian-designed meals delivered across Australia. Their menu features over 100 dishes made with fresh, locally-sourced ingredients, including 100% grass-fed beef and sustainable seafood. With no lock-in contracts and free delivery on orders over $50, the service provides flexibility and value.

name: Activate Foods
description: Activate Foods is an Australian meal delivery service that specialises in providing healthy, premade meals. They offer a variety of options, including fresh and frozen meals, to cater to different dietary needs and preferences. Their meals are designed to be convenient, delicious, and nutritious, making them a popular choice for busy individuals and families. These meals are available in NSW only – Sydney, Newcastle and the Central Coast.

name: Athletes Nutrition
description: Athletes Nutrition is an Australian meal delivery service that specialises in providing healthy and nutritious meals designed to support athletes and fitness enthusiasts. They offer a variety of meal plans tailored to different dietary needs and goals. Meals are made with high-quality ingredients and are prepared by professional chefs.

name: B(more) by Blackmores
description: Blackmores is arguably one of the most popular vitamin brands on shelves in Australia. The company has proudly coined Australia’s title of leading natural health company and are ambitious in developing and producing up-to-date products matching consumer demands and scientifically backed data. Blackmores products are high-quality ingredients developed by expert team members including naturopaths, chemists, scientists and pharmacy product developers.

name: Be Fit Food
description: Be Fit Food creates science-back meals and programs to help individuals lose weight. The dietitian-approved meals are based on the ketogenic diet and are high protein, low carb, calorie-controlled and nutrient-dense. Be Fit Food is Australia’s leading wholefood very-low-calorie-diet meal program, founded by bariatric surgeon Dr Geoffrey Draper and clinical Dietitian Kate Save. Expert Nutritionist Lauren, tried Be Fit Food to see if their Doctor and dietician-designed meals are a quick and healthy solution for those looking to lose weight.

name: Beforeyouspeak
description: Before You Speak Coffee is a unique Australian coffee company that combines the enjoyment of coffee with the benefits of superfoods. Their coffee is infused with a variety of superfood ingredients, such as collagen, probiotics, and adaptogens. They are a proud Australian brand, supporting local businesses and sourcing high-quality ingredients in their superfood-infused coffee. If you’re looking for a coffee that offers both great taste and potential health benefits, Before You Speak Coffee might be worth trying.

name: Bondi Meal Prep
description: Bondi Meal Prep is a meal prep delivery service based in Sydney, Australia. They offer a variety of fresh and healthy meal plans, designed to cater to different dietary needs and preferences. Their meals are prepared with high-quality ingredients and are delivered straight to your door, making it a convenient option for busy individuals and families.

name: Bouchée
description: Bouchée is an Australian ready-made meal company for children. Their meals are nutritious, convenient, and pre-portioned for easy heating. They offer a variety of dishes and are made with high-quality ingredients. With convenient delivery options, Bouchée provides a hassle-free solution for busy parents seeking healthy meals for their kids.

name: Bush Tucker Blends
description: Bush Tucker Blends is a company that offers a range of wholefood supplements made from traditional Australian bush foods. Their products are wild-harvested and traceable, ensuring quality and sustainability. Whether you’re looking for nutritional benefits or unique flavours, Bush Tucker Blends Australia provides a variety of options to incorporate native Australian ingredients into your diet.

name: Butcher Crowd
description: Butcher Crowd is a popular Australian meat delivery service that specializes in providing high-quality, ethically sourced meat products. They offer a wide range of cuts from various animals, including beef, lamb, pork, chicken, and seafood. Their meat is sourced from trusted farmers and suppliers, ensuring that it is fresh, delicious, and sustainable. Butcher Crowd is a reliable and convenient source of high-quality meat, delivered to your door.

name: Bébé Batch
description: Bébé Batch Bebe Batch Australia is an organic meal delivery service that specialises in providing fresh, wholesome, and nutritious meals for babies and toddlers. They offer a variety of meal plans to cater to different dietary needs and preferences, ensuring that your little one receives the essential nutrients they need for healthy growth and development. If you’re a busy parent looking for a healthy and convenient meal solution for your little one, Bebe Batch Australia is a great option.

name: Chefgood
description: Chefgood is a meal delivery service that offers ready-made meals across Australia, focusing on convenience and health. Their meals are handcrafted by chefs using natural, seasonal, and fresh ingredients and are designed by Nutritionists. Chefgood’s diverse, weekly-rotating menu of over 70 options, include tailored plans like “Slim & Trim” and “Personal Best” for specific health goals.

name: Dietlicious
description: Dietlicious is a 100% Australian-owned and operated meal service that offers healthy meals for time-poor individuals. With rave reviews and features in publications including Women’s Health and Marie Claire.

name: Dineamic
description: Dineamic delivers healthy, pre-made meals across Australia, focusing on quality and sustainability. Their meals are prepared with fresh, local, and free-range Australian produce, are never frozen, and are delivered chilled in eco-friendly, carbon-neutral packaging. Offering a diverse menu including High Protein, Low Calorie, and Monash University certified Low FODMAP options, Dineamic provides convenient, healthy eating without a lock-in contract.

name: Dinnerly
description: Dinnerly provides cost-effective meal kits, complete with easy-to-follow recipes, making home cooking accessible to all. Enjoy delicious, budget-friendly dinners with Dinnerly’s convenient service, delivered to your door. Our expert Nutritionist Lauren tried and tasted a Dinnerly meal kit to see if its the right choice for you.

name: EveryPlate
description: EveryPlate Australia is a meal kit delivery service that provides pre-portioned ingredients and easy-to-follow recipes for home-cooked meals. They aim to make cooking at home affordable and convenient, offering a variety of dishes that cater to different tastes and dietary preferences.

name: Garden of Goodness
description: Garden Of Goodness, formerly Garden of Vegan, empowers Australians to achieve optimum health by providing plant-based food & nutrition solutions, nationwide. Garden Of Goodness is Australia’s first and only ready-made meals made from 100% certified organic ingredients, completely oil-free, vegan and gluten-free. Whether you are looking to adopt a plant-based lifestyle for ethical reasons, health reasons, or both, vegan readymade meal service Garden of Goodness provides a high-quality, simple solution for people on the go.

name: GoodnessMe
description: GoodnessMe is an online health food shop stocking all-natural products and nothing artificial. They also offer monthly subscription boxes packed full of nutritionist-approved snacks and other goodies including beauty products, and deliver them to your door, Australia-wide.

name: Gourmet Dinner Service
description: With everyone leading busy lives, not all of us have the luxury of cooking meals from scratch. Throw in a big family get together and the thought of cooking becomes overwhelming! That’s where Gourmet Dinner Service (GDS) comes in. Providing wholesome, delicious, chef-cooked meals to your front-door, GDS is the meal delivery service designed to give you time back, so you can focus on what matters most to you. Our expert Nutritionist Lauren has put GDS to the test to help you choose if the brand is right for you!

name: HelloFresh
description: HelloFresh is a well-known Australian meal kit provider that offers pre-portioned ingredients and easy-to-follow recipes delivered to your door. It is one of the most popular meal kits in the world, providing over 1 billion meals to households. Our Expert Nutritionist Lauren has had the opportunity to test their latest menu (March 2025) and check out some recent updates to their online ordering. Are their meals still tasty, well-balanced and easy to make? Find out below!

name: HerbiDoor
description: HerbiDoor delivers a variety of fresh vegan and plant-based meals around Australia. The meals are chef-created, delicious and made with good-quality wholesome ingredients.

name: MACROS
description: MACROS an Australian healthy, ready-made meal service delivers fresh nutritionally balanced and healthy meals to your door. Lauren, our expert Nutritionist put MACROS to the test, to see if they really do offer nutritionally balanced meals.

name: Marley Spoon
description: Marley Spoon is one of Australia’s most popular meal kits, offering high-quality, healthy, pre-portioned recipes. As a direct competitor to HelloFresh , does Marley Spoon live up to its claim of healthy, high-quality meals? And despite their higher price point, are their meal kits good value for money? Our Expert Nutritionist Lauren puts Marley Spoon to the test.

name: My Muscle Chef
description: My Muscle Chef is one of Australia’s top-rated delivery services for every body and every goal. They offer 100+ fresh healthy ready-to-eat meals, snacks and drinks and delivery to 4500+ suburbs.

name: Nuzest
description: Nuzest Australia is a leading provider of premium plant-based nutritional supplements. Founded on the principle of good nutrition, they offer a range of scientifically- formulated products designed to support optimal health and wellness. Nutritionist Lauren reviews three of Nuzest’s Protein Plus+ range to evaluate their taste, price, and formulation.

name: QuiteLike
description: QuiteLike is a weekly meal kit subscription including fresh locally sourced ingredients and delicious seasonal recipes to match and then delivered to your door. Lauren, our expert Nutritionist has tried and tested two QuiteLike meal kits to help you decide if it’s the right choice for you!

name: Soulara
description: Looking to eat more plant-based meals but unsure of where to start? Ready-to-eat meal service Soulara offers nutrient-dense, plant-based meals delivered to your door. Soulara meals are 100% natural, superfood, and plant-powered! Nutritionist Lauren has compared and reviewed how Soulara stacks up against other ready-made meal delivery services.

name: SWIISH
description: SWIISH offers a range of lifestyle products and services from health and wellness products to fashion, beauty and online programs. Their vitamin supplements and vitamin subscriptions are delivered Australia-wide. Our expert nutritionist Lauren has used and reviewed SWIISH products to help you find the best vitamins provider.

name: Tropeaka
description: Tropeaka is an Australian brand that offers a range of high-quality, organic, and plant-based proteins, superfoods, and supplements. Their products are designed to help with goals like building lean muscle, boosting energy, and supporting overall health and wellness. They use natural, non-GMO ingredients and are known for their popular products like Lean Protein and Body Bloom. The brand also emphasises sustainability and has a foundation that supports humanitarian and environmental causes.

name: VegMeUp
description: Veg Me Up is a 100% vegan meal kit that brings the convenience of plant-based cooking to your home. You can choose from over 100 tasty, easy-to-follow recipes made with sustainable ingredients. Our Expert Nutritionist Lauren, tried Veg Me Up to see how it performs when it comes to taste, nutrition and price.

name: Vitable
description: Vitable is an Australian-owned vitamin subscription service that believes in making health easy. Vitable offers personalised vitamins delivered to your door and is a convenient, high quality and affordable solution for those interested in supplements to improve their health, but may be unsure where to start. Our expert Nutritionist Lauren has used and reviewed a range of Vitable’s vitamins and gives her honest review.

name: We Feed You
description: Convenience is at the forefront of everyone’s mind, especially when it comes to meal preparation. Additionally, health and nutrition are also a huge focus, yet many of us don’t know where to start. As a Nutritionist (you may be shocked to hear this), I believe frozen readymade meals are a great option, and services such as We Feed You, not only tick the box for convenience, but they also tick the box for quality, healthy meals whilst also supporting local ingredients and using recyclable packaging.

name: Youfoodz
description: Youfoodz Australia provides convenient & nutritious ready-made meals delivered. Discover delicious, healthy meal delivery with Youfoodz. Offering flexible meal plans like Calorie Smart, High Protein, and plant-based Flexitarian options, Youfoodz delivers fresh, pre-made meals across Australia. Enjoy over 40 weekly menu choices, saving time on cooking and meal prep. No artificial additives, just real food delivered to your door.
